title: iPhone 18 Pro review: The standard setter
method: Experience review of both models; score 9 out of 10.

findings.subject: apple-iphone-18-pro
findings.text: Scored 9/10. The variable aperture on the main camera (f/1.48 to f/4.0) gives real control over background blur, and the cameras were judged excellent and versatile.

findings.subject: apple-iphone-18-pro
findings.text: The redesigned vapour chamber kept heat in check; one warm spell during demanding video testing cooled down quickly.

findings.subject: apple-iphone-18-pro
findings.text: Battery life ran from about a day and a half to two days depending on use.

findings.subject: apple-iphone-18-pro
findings.text: The new AI-powered Siri was still in beta and struggled with complex requests.

findings.subject: apple-iphone-18-pro
findings.text: Same size as the iPhone 17 Pro but slightly heavier; the smaller Dynamic Island can show three Live Activities at once.

title: iPhone 18 Pro review: More of a great thing
method: Experience review of both models by Chance Miller.

findings.subject: apple-iphone-18-pro
findings.text: Heavier than the iPhone 17 Pro; the new colour-matched back replaces last year's two-tone look.

findings.subject: apple-iphone-18-pro-max
findings.text: At 249 g the Pro Max reached the reviewer's limit for a comfortable phone to hold.

findings.subject: apple-iphone-18-pro
findings.text: The Dynamic Island is about a quarter smaller because part of Face ID moved under the display.

findings.subject: apple-iphone-18-pro
findings.text: The variable-aperture main camera gave cleaner low-light shots and creative options such as starbursts; the new Pro controls add shutter speed and a histogram.

findings.subject: apple-iphone-18-pro-max
findings.text: The reviewer comfortably got more than a full day from the Pro Max.

findings.subject: apple-iphone-18-pro
findings.text: An incremental update: not a must-upgrade from the iPhone 17 Pro, but worthwhile coming from an iPhone 16 Pro or older. US prices rose by $100.

title: iPhone 18 Pro Reviews: Excellent Yet... Meh?
method: Review roundup. The battery results are Tom's Guide's standard battery test as reported by MacRumors.

findings.subject: apple-iphone-18-pro
findings.text: Across the reviews collected, the common view was a strong but incremental update: good for owners of older iPhones, hard to justify for iPhone 17 Pro owners.

title: Samsung Galaxy S26 and S26 Plus review: Don't buy the wrong one
method: Experience review of both models by Joe Maring.

findings.subject: samsung-galaxy-s26-plus
findings.text: Judged no longer worth buying: it adds only a bigger screen over the S26 yet sits close in price to the S26 Ultra.

findings.subject: samsung-galaxy-s26-plus
findings.text: The camera hardware is largely unchanged from earlier generations, and the main camera struggled with close subjects, low light and motion.

findings.subject: samsung-galaxy-s26-plus
findings.text: Charging is slow next to rivals such as the OnePlus 15.

findings.subject: samsung-galaxy-s26
findings.text: The S26 was called perfectly serviceable for Samsung owners upgrading, with 256 GB base storage and seven years of updates, though the Pixel 10 or OnePlus 15 offer better value.

findings.subject: samsung-galaxy-s26-plus
findings.text: The Snapdragon 8 Elite Gen 5 led its rivals in CPU and GPU benchmarks.

title: Samsung Galaxy Z Fold 8 review: Wider really is better
method: Experience review by Sam Rutherford; score 8.9 out of 10. Battery: Engadget's local video rundown on the cover screen.

records.subject: samsung-galaxy-z-fold8
records.note: 28 h 14 min, on the smaller cover screen

findings.subject: samsung-galaxy-z-fold8
findings.text: Scored 8.9/10. The wider shape and 4:3 inner screen cut letterboxing for videos and suit landscape games; the anti-glare coating helps.

findings.subject: samsung-galaxy-z-fold8
findings.text: The biggest drawback is the missing telephoto camera: only a main and an ultra-wide camera.

findings.subject: samsung-galaxy-z-fold8
findings.text: Wired charging rises to 45 W and wireless to 20 W.

findings.subject: samsung-galaxy-z-fold8
findings.text: It now opens flat to 180 degrees but loses the half-open tabletop position.

findings.subject: samsung-galaxy-z-fold8
findings.text: Matches the Fold8 Ultra for performance and brightness for $200 less, so the reviewer found it the better buy unless zoom matters.

title: Samsung Galaxy Z Fold8 Review: Bigger Changes, Bigger Compromises
method: Malaysian review by Kiran Ganesan of the RM7,299 model.

findings.subject: samsung-galaxy-z-fold8
findings.text: Light and pocketable, with a barely visible crease and a responsive fingerprint sensor.

findings.subject: samsung-galaxy-z-fold8
findings.text: The wide body is awkward one-handed and the glass back is slippery.

findings.subject: samsung-galaxy-z-fold8
findings.text: The 4:3 inner screen is excellent for video, but apps such as Instagram and Facebook are not yet optimised for it.

findings.subject: samsung-galaxy-z-fold8
findings.text: It heats up under sustained load, especially in a case.

findings.subject: samsung-galaxy-z-fold8
findings.text: Battery life disappointed the reviewer, at roughly nine and a half hours of screen time on the inner display.

findings.subject: samsung-galaxy-z-fold8
findings.text: Sound from the speakers felt unbalanced.

findings.subject: samsung-galaxy-z-fold8
findings.text: Called an effective first foldable, but features such as the telephoto camera and Flex mode seem held back for the Ultra.

title: Samsung Galaxy Z Fold 8 Ultra review: Nice upgrades, but not quite ultra
method: Experience review by Sam Rutherford; score 8.8 out of 10. Battery: Engadget's local video rundown on the cover screen.

records.subject: samsung-galaxy-z-fold8-ultra
records.note: 32 h 11 min, on the smaller cover screen

records.subject: samsung-galaxy-z-fold7
records.note: 26 h 22 min, as quoted for comparison

findings.subject: samsung-galaxy-z-fold8-ultra
findings.text: Scored 8.8/10. The larger battery gave one of the longest video rundowns the reviewer had recorded on any phone.

findings.subject: samsung-galaxy-z-fold8-ultra
findings.text: The crease is faint enough to go unnoticed, and an anti-reflective coating reduces glare on the 8-inch inner screen.

findings.subject: samsung-galaxy-z-fold8-ultra
findings.text: Keeps the 3x telephoto the standard Fold8 lacks; photos were excellent in all lighting, though the reviewer still preferred Pixel results.

findings.subject: samsung-galaxy-z-fold8-ultra
findings.text: The Ultra name felt unearned: performance matches the cheaper Fold8, which the reviewer recommends unless multitasking space or zoom matter.

title: Samsung Galaxy Z Flip 8 review
method: Experience review by Abhijeet Mishra.

findings.subject: samsung-galaxy-z-flip8
findings.text: The cover screen is the highlight: bright, and with One UI 9's home screen, dock and app drawer it is practical to use without opening the phone.

findings.subject: samsung-galaxy-z-flip8
findings.text: A conservative heat limit makes performance drop noticeably during long gaming sessions.

findings.subject: samsung-galaxy-z-flip8
findings.text: Charging stays at 25 W and felt slow for 2026.

findings.subject: samsung-galaxy-z-flip8
findings.text: The cameras are unchanged from the Flip7 and there is no zoom camera.

findings.subject: samsung-galaxy-z-flip8
findings.text: Seven years of OS updates are promised.

findings.subject: samsung-galaxy-z-flip8
findings.text: Too similar to the Flip7 to justify upgrading from it; better for owners of older flip phones or regular phones.

title: Review: The Pixel 11 Pro XL is great, but a little too early for Google's futuristic vision
method: Experience review by Will Sattelberg.

findings.subject: google-pixel-11-pro-xl
findings.text: Very bright and easy to read outdoors.

findings.subject: google-pixel-11-pro-xl
findings.text: The refreshed main sensor and upgraded 5x telephoto impressed, Night Sight became much faster, and the new Camera Looks were the reviewer's favourite addition in years.

findings.subject: google-pixel-11-pro-xl
findings.text: Night Sight sometimes brightens dark scenes unrealistically.

findings.subject: google-pixel-11-pro-xl
findings.text: Days often ended with around 40% left.

findings.subject: google-pixel-11-pro-xl
findings.text: The Tensor G6 still trails Snapdragon chips in GPU power, and the base 256 GB model has 12 GB of RAM.

findings.subject: google-pixel-11-pro-xl
findings.text: The rear HiLight notification light was judged a poor idea that also dims the flashlight, and the proactive AI features rarely helped.

findings.subject: google-pixel-11-pro-xl
findings.text: A deep scratch appeared on the screen within a week despite the scratch-resistance claims.

title: vivo X300 Ultra review: Pricey camera phone colossus
method: Experience review by Hadlee Simons.

findings.subject: vivo-x300-ultra
findings.text: A distinctive camera system with a 35mm main camera and extensive video tools, including log recording, aimed at enthusiasts.

findings.subject: vivo-x300-ultra
findings.text: Battery endurance was impressive, at around seven to eight hours of screen time in typical use.

findings.subject: vivo-x300-ultra
findings.text: Sustained performance was poor: it ran hotter than rivals in the GPU stress test.

findings.subject: vivo-x300-ultra
findings.text: Heavy, with a very thick camera bump.

findings.subject: vivo-x300-ultra
findings.text: Very expensive, but recommended to camera enthusiasts as an alternative to the Galaxy S26 Ultra or OPPO Find X9 Ultra.

title: vivo X300 Ultra Camera test
method: DXOMARK camera protocol (lab and field). Overall score 170, 4th in DXOMARK's global ranking at the time.

findings.subject: vivo-x300-ultra
findings.text: Strong portraits with natural skin tones, excellent zoom detail and sharp, low-noise results in bright light.

findings.subject: vivo-x300-ultra
findings.text: Exposure, colour and sharpness can vary in difficult scenes, low light brings noise and ghosting, and AI processing sometimes looks unnatural.

title: Oppo Find X9 Ultra Review: The Camera Alone Is Stunning
method: Malaysian review by John Law.

findings.subject: oppo-find-x9-ultra
findings.text: Very detailed photos with vivid colours; the optional Hasselblad kit suits architectural shots.

findings.subject: oppo-find-x9-ultra
findings.text: Quality falls off beyond 10x zoom, and the camera is sluggish with the add-on lens kit.

findings.subject: oppo-find-x9-ultra
findings.text: Battery life went beyond two days of typical use.

findings.subject: oppo-find-x9-ultra
findings.text: The textured back is secure in the hand, though the shutter button sits awkwardly far from the edge.

findings.subject: oppo-find-x9-ultra
findings.text: Expensive for general buyers; best for photographers willing to pay a premium.

title: Oppo Find X9 Ultra Camera test
method: DXOMARK camera protocol (lab and field). Overall score 170, 4th in DXOMARK's global ranking at the time.

findings.subject: oppo-find-x9-ultra
findings.text: Bright, natural-looking photos and video, high detail across zoom ranges, very low noise and natural portrait mode; its bokeh and telephoto sub-scores were the highest DXOMARK had recorded.

findings.subject: oppo-find-x9-ultra
findings.text: Focus can shift or pick the wrong subject in video, noise shows in backlit and low-light scenes, and colour casts can be strong in low light.

title: The Oppo Find N6 is the best foldable you can't buy, again
method: Experience piece by Ben Schoon after several weeks as a daily phone.

findings.subject: oppo-find-n6
findings.text: The crease is nearly invisible and held up better than on rival foldables, though it still shows in some light.

findings.subject: oppo-find-n6
findings.text: Light and thin for a book-style foldable, with better dust resistance than other foldables.

findings.subject: oppo-find-n6
findings.text: Battery life gave roughly five to seven hours or more of screen time, and heat stayed well controlled.

findings.subject: oppo-find-n6
findings.text: ColorOS felt less polished than rivals' software, and there is no Qi2 magnetic charging.

findings.subject: oppo-find-n6
findings.text: Called the best foldable on the market, held back mainly by limited availability outside Asia.

title: Honor Magic V6 review: A mechanical marvel
method: Experience review by Daniel Cooper; score 8.2 out of 10. Battery: Engadget's video rundown on the main (inner) screen.

records.subject: honor-magic-v6
records.note: 30 h 12 min, on the main (inner) screen

findings.subject: honor-magic-v6
findings.text: Scored 8.2/10. Outstanding battery life: in normal use it rarely dropped below half.

findings.subject: honor-magic-v6
findings.text: Slim yet sturdier than the Magic V5, now rated IP68 and IP69, with a tougher cover screen.

findings.subject: honor-magic-v6
findings.text: Smooth in everything the reviewer tried, including gaming, without troublesome heat.

findings.subject: honor-magic-v6
findings.text: Portrait edges looked harsh and the AI-assisted 100x zoom promised more than it delivered.

findings.subject: honor-magic-v6
findings.text: MagicOS showed many interface inconsistencies, which held back otherwise excellent hardware; seven years of updates are promised.

title: realme GT8 Pro review: The OnePlus 15 that never was
method: Experience review by Hadlee Simons.

findings.subject: realme-gt-8-pro
findings.text: Excellent endurance of about two days of typical use, and very fast wired and wireless charging.

findings.subject: realme-gt-8-pro
findings.text: The 200MP telephoto out-zooms the OnePlus 15.

findings.subject: realme-gt-8-pro
findings.text: Main and ultra-wide shots were oversaturated and inconsistent, with noisy ultra-wide photos.

findings.subject: realme-gt-8-pro
findings.text: Severe throttling under sustained load, only partly improved by software updates.

findings.subject: realme-gt-8-pro
findings.text: Four OS upgrades and five years of security patches trail OnePlus and Samsung, and the AI notification summaries were more annoying than useful.

findings.subject: realme-gt-8-pro
findings.text: Undercuts the OnePlus 15 in Europe with a sharper screen and better zoom, but sustained performance and camera consistency hold it back.

title: iQOO 15 review - 3 great aspects alongside a reasonable price
method: Malaysian review by Kok Kee of the RM3,699 model.

findings.subject: iqoo-15
findings.text: Demanding games held close to 60 fps at their highest settings, helped by iQOO's extra graphics chip.

findings.subject: iqoo-15
findings.text: A very bright, wide-colour 2K display; the flat design is easier to use.

findings.subject: iqoo-15
findings.text: Long battery life in the reviewer's standard test, and fast charging with the 90W charger in the box.

findings.subject: iqoo-15
findings.text: Performance roughly halves once it throttles in the most demanding games, worse with a case on.

findings.subject: iqoo-15
findings.text: Ads in notifications, preinstalled apps, and an auto-brightness bug that capped peak brightness.

findings.subject: iqoo-15
findings.text: Called a great phone for gaming at a very reasonable price.

title: I benchmarked my first Snapdragon 8 Elite Gen 5 phone and it (almost) lives up to the hype
method: Benchmark session by Robert Triggs with the phone's gaming mode off. Scores are not recorded here because the device was later delisted from 3DMark (see the related report).

findings.subject: redmagic-11-pro
findings.text: Clearly faster than the REDMAGIC 10 Pro in CPU and graphics tests, though a few per cent short of Qualcomm's own reference results.

findings.subject: redmagic-11-pro
findings.text: Runs very hot; the cooling keeps performance more consistent over long sessions rather than raising peak frame rates.

title: REDMAGIC 11 Pro phones have cooling fans, but they just got busted for cheating
summary: UL removed the REDMAGIC 11 Pro and Pro+ from several 3DMark rankings after finding that the phones recognised benchmark apps and ran them at higher performance than other apps.

title: The HUAWEI Mate X7 has the best cameras I've ever used on a foldable
method: Hands-on by Paul Jones and Andy Walker after about a day of use (not a full review).

findings.subject: huawei-mate-x7
findings.text: Hands-on: camera quality rivals regular flagships, with wide dynamic range, accurate colour and steady video; low-light food shots were slightly soft.

findings.subject: huawei-mate-x7
findings.text: Hands-on: thin, light and durable, with IP58/IP59 ratings and a less visible crease than rivals, though the hinge felt looser.

findings.subject: huawei-mate-x7
findings.text: Hands-on: its chip limits it to 4G, not 5G.

findings.subject: huawei-mate-x7
findings.text: Hands-on: no official Google services, so Google Wallet and RCS chats don't work and apps need workarounds.

title: HUAWEI Pura 90s Pro Max hands-on: Amazing, but Googleless
method: Extended hands-on by Edgar Cervantes after several weeks of use.

findings.subject: huawei-pura-90s-pro-max
findings.text: Outstanding cameras, especially in daylight, at night and for close-ups; it won the reviewer's camera award.

findings.subject: huawei-pura-90s-pro-max
findings.text: Some detail is lost when zooming in low light, a light-painting mode kept failing, and the camera bump is enormous.

findings.subject: huawei-pura-90s-pro-max
findings.text: Battery life was exceptional, with fast wired and wireless charging.

findings.subject: huawei-pura-90s-pro-max
findings.text: No Google services and a lot of preinstalled apps; recommended only for tech-savvy users willing to use workarounds.

title: Huawei Mate 80 Pro Hands On: The Return Of The Mate Series
method: Malaysian hands-on by John Law before the local launch (limited testing; not a full review).

findings.subject: huawei-mate-80-pro
findings.text: Hands-on: a sharp, smooth 120 Hz display.

findings.subject: huawei-mate-80-pro
findings.text: Hands-on: the triple camera looked promising, with an AI feature that helps frame shots; low light was not yet tested.

findings.subject: huawei-mate-80-pro
findings.text: Hands-on: solid yet light, though the design closely resembles recent OPPO and Samsung flagships.

findings.subject: huawei-mate-80-pro
findings.text: Hands-on: no Google services, as on all Huawei phones since 2019.
